title: CursorPaginatedResponse

nextCursor.description: Cursor for retrieving the next page. If null, there are no more pages available.

total.description: Total number of items available across all pages

data.description: Array of data items for the current page

limit.description: Page size limit for pagination. Maximum allowed is 1000 items per request.

description: Generic paginated response using cursor-based pagination for efficient data retrieval
